gdoc.body:
Control words
The first run of the hanging text, given on two input lines, so that the indention is seen on its second output line.
The second run, after a break, starts again at the hanging indention.
GML Generalized Markup Language: the label before the tab is as wide as the indention.
Too-long-term A label wider than the indention is followed by one blank.
Of the three skips above (one line at the end of the indented block, two lines and one line after it) only the two-line one is kept. Two equal skips make one.
Headings Run-in heading. The text after a level five heading defined NBR continues on its line. A heading again After .dh 5 alone the level breaks again.
